title: Cybersecurity operation thwarts attack on UK supermarket fridges and freezers
summary_full: News of operation comes after supermarkets in at least seven European countries hit by cyber-attacksA secret government cybersecurity operation recently thwarted a cyber-attack on fridges and freezers in UK supermarkets, warehouses, restaurants, petrol stations and stadiums, it has emerged.The attack would have been similar to those that have caused many millions of euros of damage in continental Europe in recent months. But, while many retailers have now been protected, researchers warned that many more could still be vulnerable. Continue reading...
